implementation_notes: RSpec or Minitest; shared examples for cross-cutting rules, `aggregate_failures` so one example reports all mismatches, and Capybara or system tests for the thin end-to-end layer. FactoryBot for data, but assert on behaviour.
code_sketch:
RSpec.describe Order, :aggregate_failures do
  it 'applies the discount' do
    order = described_class.new(total: 3000, discount: 0.1)
    expect(order.total).to eq(2700)
  end
end
pitfalls: Model specs that test ActiveRecord callbacks instead of domain rules
Feature specs that re-test what a request spec already covers
